verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requests an optional tipping control on the minting page, establishing concrete frontend payment behavior.
Initial target-specific implementation claim identifying the preset and custom tip controls added to the mint page.
The client unambiguously accepts the immediately preceding preset and custom tip design, establishing concrete mint-page UI behavior.
First concrete tipping failure: a referral mint completed after selecting a $1 tip, but the tip did not work.
Post-failure target-specific claim explaining that tipping uses a separate USDC transfer and that canceling it prevents tip delivery.
The client establishes the separate post-mint tip transaction and requires UI copy warning buyers about that second transaction.
Target-specific implementation claim for a distinct self-tip path: tipping is disabled when the payer is the configured founder wallet.
First concrete verification of actual tip delivery from another minting wallet: the client confirms receiving the $3 tip.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just minted using 'no referral code' and giving a '$1 tip'.

\- Tipping isn't working.

\- Tickets and commissions from 'no referral code' buys still aren't showing up on the leaderboard or in the NFT attributes

also, after i minted, another transaction (shown in screenshot) popped up, but i cancelled it and the mint worked fine.
Do you know why this second transaction appeared, was that for the tip?

execution.observed_behavior: On a no-referral mint with a selected $1 tip, the client reports that tipping did not work and that an unexpected follow-up transaction appeared and was canceled.
